summary: Install from Operators > OperatorHub: search Ansible Automation Platform, pick stable-2.x (namespace-scoped, no admin rights) or stable-2.x-cluster-scoped (admin on all namespaces), set mode, namespace and approval strategy; afterwards the controller, hub, EDA and Lightspeed CRs are listed and the operator shows Succeeded.
